brief:
**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, VA, the focus today is on community events wrapping up 2026, including a Veterans Parade tomorrow, alongside a Freeze Warning affecting nearby counties through Sunday morning. No major law enforcement incidents, crashes, or other emergencies reported in the core area in the last 24 hours. Regionally, Southwest Virginia sees a new grant program to expand behavioral health workforce training.

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:** Freeze Warning issued for McDowell County, WV (and nearby counties including Buchanan and Dickenson, VA) until 10:00 a.m. Sunday, November 8, 2026, by NWS Charleston WV.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)

Tazewell, VA forecast: High near 47°F with partly to mostly cloudy skies; low around 33°F overnight. Winds light.[[2]](https://www.wunderground.com/hourly/us/va/tazewell)

Nothing reported on power outages, water notices, or major road closures on US-19, US-460, or other key routes in the core.

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours on severe weather, interstate issues, or large incidents.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County Board of Supervisors previously approved a nine-month moratorium on data centers (effective until July 28, 2027) to develop zoning and development standards.[[3]](https://www.25newsnow.com/2026/10/31/tazewell-county-imposes-9-month-data-center-moratorium/)

Tazewell Circuit Court rescheduled a hearing on a challenge to the abortion amendment (Ballot Question 1) to November 24, 2026.[[4]](https://x.com/TFFVA/status/2118790968375750785)

**Region:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Tazewell Today announced its holiday event lineup for November and December 2026, including a Veterans Parade at 2 p.m. Sunday, November 8, along Main Street in downtown Tazewell (with a Quilt of Valor presentation to a local WWII veteran); Bingo at Nuckolls Hall on November 15 at 3 p.m.; and the 6th Annual T-Town Turkey Trot 5K on November 26 at 9 a.m. (fundraiser benefiting a local food pantry).[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)[[5]](https://www.wvva.com/video/2026/11/06/tazewell-hold-veterans-day-parade-nov-8-2/)[[6]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/06/tazewell-hold-veterans-day-parade-nov-8/)

Bluefield University introduced the Bluefield Promise program.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)

**Region:** A grant program aims to expand Southwest Virginia’s behavioral health workforce by making training more affordable.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Veterans Parade, 2 p.m. Sunday, November 8, downtown Tazewell (Tazewell Today / Chamber of Commerce).[[6]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/06/tazewell-hold-veterans-day-parade-nov-8/)
- Freeze Warning expires 10 a.m. Sunday.
- Tazewell Circuit Court hearing on abortion amendment challenge: November 24.[[4]](https://x.com/TFFVA/status/2118790968375750785)
